policyInfo.name: Android BYOD - Trusted Root CA
purpose: Deploys the organization's root CA certificate to the work profile of personally-owned (BYOD) Android Enterprise devices so the device trusts certificates issued by that CA.
Establishes the chain of trust required by SCEP and PKCS certificate profiles. A SCEP or PKCS certificate profile fails if the device does not trust the root CA.
Lets Wi-Fi, VPN and email profiles that use certificate-based authentication validate servers and certificates issued by the internal CA.
Deploy it to the same user/device groups that receive the SCEP/PKCS certificate profile and the Wi-Fi/VPN/email profiles that use the certificate.

intuneAdminCenterPath.navigation: Devices > Manage devices > Configuration > Create > New policy
steps: Sign in to the Microsoft Intune admin center (https://intune.microsoft.com).
Go to Devices > Manage devices > Configuration > Create > New policy.
Profile type: under 'Personally-Owned Work Profile', select 'Trusted certificate', then select Create.
Basics: enter the Name and Description, then select Next.
Configuration settings: upload the root CA certificate (.cer file), then select Next.
Scope tags: select the scope tags (Default if none), then select Next.
Assignments: select the BYOD user/device groups (the same groups as the SCEP/PKCS profile), then select Next.
Review + create: review the settings and select Create.

policy.description: Trusted root CA certificate for Android Enterprise personally-owned work profile (BYOD) devices.
